title: RAILS: Retrieval-Augmented Incremental LLM Clustering at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2609.24464v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Using a Large Language Model (LLM) as the clusterer at production scale is hard: prompts cannot hold the entire label space, and per-document serial processing does not deliver the throughput real workloads require. We present RAILS, a retrieval-augmented incremental LLM clusterer that turns clustering into a simple loop over a growing label pool and scales through document batching with bounded concurrency. On six public benchmarks RAILS exceeds the strongest prior LLM-clustering method on average, lifting accuracy from 51.2% to 59.3%, NMI from 67.2% to 74.8%, and ARI from 45.4% to 54.7%. We further report production-deployment evidence from a SaaS ticket-topic-discovery pipeline, where RAILS has replaced a traditional HDBSCAN stage with higher clustering quality, transparent prompt-driven control, and stateful incremental operation.

translated_title: RAILS：大规模检索增强的增量式LLM聚类
translated_abstract: 在生产规模下使用大语言模型（LLM）作为聚类器非常困难：提示词无法容纳整个标签空间，而逐文档的串行处理也无法满足真实工作负载所需的吞吐量。我们提出了RAILS，一种检索增强的增量式LLM聚类器，它将聚类转化为对一个不断增长的标签池的简单循环，并通过带有限并发的文档批处理实现规模化。在六个公开基准上，RAILS平均超越了此前最强的LLM聚类方法，将准确率从51.2%提升至59.3%，NMI从67.2%提升至74.8%，ARI从45.4%提升至54.7%。我们还报告了来自SaaS工单主题发现流水线的生产部署证据，其中RAILS已取代传统的HDBSCAN阶段，实现了更高的聚类质量、透明的基于提示词的控制以及有状态的增量运行。
tldr: RAILS提出了一种检索增强的增量式LLM聚类方法，通过不断增长的标签池循环和有限并发的文档批处理实现大规模聚类，在六个公开基准上平均超越此前最强方法，并已在生产环境中成功取代HDBSCAN。
en_tdlr: RAILS is a retrieval-augmented incremental LLM clusterer that scales clustering through a growing label pool and bounded-concurrency document batching, outperforming prior LLM clustering methods on six benchmarks and replacing HDBSCAN in production deployment.
